text: The user asked the assistant to reach 133 using 5, 9, 25, and 75 with +, −, ×, and ÷, using each number at most once and forbidding 125 as an intermediate result. After several unsuccessful attempts, the assistant exhaustively checked the standard arithmetic expressions and found no solution. The user confirmed the puzzle has no solution and asked to leave it there.

The user asked for an expression equal to 133 using 5, 9, 25, and 75, each at most once, with +, −, ×, and ÷, and with 125 forbidden as an intermediate. After several incorrect attempts, the user checked the puzzle and concluded it has no solution. The assistant agreed and acknowledged that it should have said so plainly sooner. The user then asked to leave the puzzle there.

The assistant was asked to reach 133 using 5, 9, 25, and 75, with each number used at most once and 125 forbidden as an intermediate. After several incorrect attempts, exhaustive checking found no solution under standard binary arithmetic. The user independently confirmed the puzzle has no solution and said to leave it there; the assistant agreed and apologized for the repeated incorrect answers.
